alter_constraints.name: compact_continuations_context_check
alter_constraints.expression:
CASE
    WHEN (context ? 'encoding'::text) THEN ((((context ->> 'encoding'::text) = 'feishu-snapshot-aead/1'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((context -> 'ciphertext'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((context - 'encoding'::text) - 'ciphertext'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((length((context ->> 'ciphertext'::text)) >= 40) AND (length((context ->> 'ciphertext'::text)) <= 1398140))) IS TRUE)
    ELSE (octet_length((context)::text) <= 1048576)
END

    WHEN (snapshot ? 'encoding'::text) THEN ((((snapshot ->> 'encoding'::text) = 'feishu-snapshot-aead/1'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((snapshot -> 'ciphertext'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((snapshot - 'encoding'::text) - 'ciphertext'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((length((snapshot ->> 'ciphertext'::text)) >= 40) AND (length((snapshot ->> 'ciphertext'::text)) <= 1398140))) IS TRUE)

END

baseline_checks.name: tool_invocations_result_check
baseline_checks.expression:
(((state = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (outcome_kind IS NULL) AND (result_version IS NULL) AND (accepted_result IS NULL) AND (approval_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_request_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NULL) AND (evidence_ref IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'completed'::text) AND (outcome_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (result_version = 1) AND (accepted_result IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(accepted_result) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((accepted_result)::text) <=
CASE
    WHEN ((tool_id = 'feishu_docx_read'::text) AND (outcome_kind = 'success'::text) AND ((accepted_result ->> 'encoding'::text) = 'feishu-aead/2'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((accepted_result -> 'ciphertext'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((accepted_result -> 'keyId'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((((accepted_result - 'encoding'::text) - 'ciphertext'::text) - 'keyId'::text) = '{}'::jsonb)) THEN 321000

END) AND (accepted_attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (((outcome_kind = 'approval_pending'::text) AND (approval_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((outcome_kind <> 'approval_pending'::text) AND (approval_id IS NULL)))))
